slides.title: Tigray election preparations are underway, Election Board says

slides.text: **Wazema Radio** reports the Board is preparing **regional and federal elections** in Tigray. **No date** is announced.
The Board asked Tigray's **federal caretaker administration** to name a **liaison body**, Wazema reports.
On **Oct 16**, the **TPLF rejected** that administration, saying its decisions have **no legality**, Addis Standard reported.
**Choose dialogue, protect civilians.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Sources: Wazema Radio, Nov 25, 2026; Addis Standard, Oct 2026
